notable_absence.finding: This page never gates any action on an organization role - all its procedures (change password, activate MFA, link social accounts, view activity log) are self-service actions on the user's own account, orthogonal to the capella-role:* organization-role catalog entirely. No edition badges or server-version-string citations appear either (both known recurring anomalies absent here, as expected for a personal-account settings page).

cross_component_finding: This is the first page in the batch to surface authentication mechanisms (SSO, MFA, social sign-in) as first-class subjects, distinct from the capella-role:* authorization catalog. I introduced a new auth: namespace rather than folding these into capella: or security: (used loosely by a sibling batch's cloud/security/security.json for the same concepts, unreconciled) because SSO/MFA/social-sign-in are a genuinely different primitive family - they answer 'how do you prove who you are', never 'what are you allowed to do'. The two axes interact only through gating (see ui-auth/*.json for requiresCapellaRole gating who can configure auth:sso), never through conflation - no page states that an authentication mechanism IS a role or vice versa.
